column1: # corpus coverage classification manifest -- the data half of test_gate_corpus_coverage_classified.sh.
# ⛔ THIS FILE IS NOT AUTHORITY FOR "THE CORPUS IS COVERED". It is authority for "every corpus subtree has been
# CLASSIFIED". The gate proves TOTALITY (nothing falls through) and REFERENTIAL INTEGRITY (named harnesses and
# rows still exist). It does NOT prove a named harness genuinely sweeps its subtree -- a harness can exist and be
# vacuous (measured instance: prolog-parser-corpus-vacuous-gate-422-files). Vacuity is that row's question, not this gate's.
# ⭐ WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT A HAND LIST: the gate checks this file against the LIVE tree every run. An entry that
# goes stale, or a subtree nobody added, turns the gate RED and names it. That is the property a hand-maintained
# bash list cannot have -- the defect measured in SCRIP 1d38f034, where 98 crosscheck entries left the SNOBOL4
# board silently while it kept printing GATE OK / MISSING=0. Omission here CANNOT hide; that is the whole point.
# FIELDS: kind <TAB> path <TAB> bucket <TAB> evidence
#   kind=EXCLUDE -> path is a PREFIX, matched at any depth, removed before grouping (mirrors util_corpus_coverage_denominator.sh)
#   kind=SUBTREE -> path is a depth-2 group of what remains; bucket is GATED or ROWD
#   GATED evidence = a script under ../harness/scripts/ that must exist.  ROWD evidence = a task topic that must exist and NOT be DONE.
# ⛔ DO NOT PIN COUNTS IN THIS FILE (hq_C s272 §1, RULES.md:105). The gate recomputes them live.
EXCLUDE
